singapore.title: Dancing to be prescribed for Parkinson’s patients at Singapore hospital
detail: SINGAPORE – From February 2027, patients at Alexandra Hospital (AH) diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease will be prescribed dance as part of their treatment.
